title: Paper 2: seed-dependent camera generalisation of the optic-disc frame estimator (FE), ground-truth evaluation
nature: engineering localisation-accuracy study; not a diagnostic accuracy study

data.source: RFMiD 1.0 official Test (640 images), camera by native resolution: A TOPCON 3D OCT-2000 (2144x1424), B Kowa VX-10 alpha (4288x2848, control), C TOPCON TRC-NW300 (2048x1536)
data.sample: A 50, B 30, C 50 originals drawn by fe/p2_select_annotation_sample.py (seed 20261112) after excluding 12 Test images duplicated in IDRiD (FE training data); 13 blinded intra-rater repeats (A 5, B 3, C 5); no replacement of ungradable images
prior_exposure_of_test: E11: FE v1.2 frames generated as model input; no per-image or per-camera output viewed
E18: FE v1.4 frames generated as model input; one aggregate printed (valid 82% over val-B 318 + Test 640 = 958)
E13 frame files and 16-image figures used train+validation only

reference_standard.annotator: kim_md (ophthalmology resident), same protocol as fe_disc_v1: 6-8 boundary points per disc, ellipse fit, inner edge of Elschnig ring, peripapillary atrophy excluded, blurred edge of swollen discs included
reference_standard.blinding: blinded to FE output, dataset labels and sample codes; no AI preliminary annotation; camera cannot be blinded (resolution and colour are visible)
reference_standard.senior_review: images flagged uncertain are reviewed by a senior ophthalmologist before the reference lock; the outcome is written into the annotation file and documented in review_note*
reference_standard.lock: fe/p2_lock_reference.py records annotation file hashes before any comparison with FE
reference_standard.limitation: single annotator; intra-rater agreement from 13 repeats

definitions.failure: predicted centre more than 0.2 r_d from the reference centre (r_d = reference equivalent radius after mapping to the 384 crop), or no centre
definitions.valid_frame: status ok and radius 15-46 px at 384 (single forward pass, as in the seed review)
definitions.cells: valid-correct, valid-failure (silent failure), rejected-correct (rule false rejection), rejected-failure
definitions.models: nine checkpoints (fe_v14 and fe_v14p seeds 42-44; fe_v14 IDRiD fractions 10/25/50% seed 42) by single forward pass; 3-seed probability ensembles per track; deployed pipeline onfm/frame.py (6-view TTA; valid also requires no TTA-spread flag) for both tracks with the deployed thresholds (research 0.138, product 0.297 r_d), not recalibrated

primary.hypothesis: within a track, models differing only in training seed differ in failure on unseen cameras
primary.test: Cochran Q across seeds 42/43/44 on assessable camera A and C originals (n about 100), separately for research (fe_v14) and product (fe_v14p); Holm adjustment over the two tracks; significant if adjusted p < 0.05
primary.reporting: failure proportion per seed with Wilson 95% CI; a non-significant result is reported as such

control.criterion: camera B failure <= 10% for all six seed models
control.if_unmet: reported as unmet; camera A/C results interpreted with caution

secondary: failure, valid rate, median centre error and radius absolute error per camera and model (Wilson 95% CI)
four-cell table per model and camera; silent-failure and false-rejection proportions; correctness of radius < 15 px rejections
self-detection on A and C: sensitivity and specificity of the TTA-spread flag and of any pipeline flag for failures
intra-rater agreement: median centre difference (r_d) and relative radius difference of repeat pairs
sensitivity: primary test and failure rates repeated excluding images flagged uncertain
exclusions: not-assessable images excluded from FE metrics and counted per camera
sample_size_rationale: 50 per camera gives a Wilson 95% CI half-width of at most about 14 percentage points; A and C pooled (about 100) for the paired seed comparison
single_evaluation: fe/p2_cam_locked_eval.py runs once; it refuses to run on any hash mismatch or if results exist; deviations are reported

selftest.result: preprocessing parity 0.00 on 20 training images; plumbing on fe_disc_v1 (61 images); synthetic tests as expected
